function.name: createTicket
function.description: These tool is used for creating support ticket on zendesk.

name.description: Full name of the customer. If not already known, ask the user before calling this tool.

email.description: Customer's email address used for communication and ticket creation in Zendesk.

issue.description: Clear and detailed description of the customer's issue. Summarize the problem, including what the user reported and any troubleshooting steps already attempted.

phone.description: Customer's phone number including country code (e.g., +919876543210). Optional but recommended.

severity.description: Severity level of the issue. Use 'standard' for normal issues and 'high' for urgent issues (e.g., service down, repeated failures, or customer frustration).

customerId.description: Unique ID of the customer obtained from lookupCustomer tool. If not available, leave empty or null.
